title: auth.contacts_page
description: One keyset page of deliverable addresses — the PULL half of the contact projection, next to the user.contact.changed stream. Returns {contacts: [{user_id, email, phone, email_verified, phone_verified, language}], next: <cursor|null>}; feed next back as after. Exists because a stream has no repair: a consumer deployed after the accounts, a handler down while facts aged out, a bulk QuerySet.update() no model observer can see, or a fleet where the events were never emitted at all. Keyset rather than offset so a concurrent write cannot make the walk skip or duplicate a row. language is null until a host's AUTH_USER_MODEL defines one — auth stores no language field. addressable_only defaults to true (guests with neither address are not contacts). Service-only by construction: a bulk read of personal contact data on the internal transport, never to be given an HTTP surface.

after.description: Keyset cursor: the last user id of the previous page. Omit or null for the first page.

limit.description: Page size; defaults to 200, capped at 1000.

since.description: ISO-8601 instant. Restricts the page to accounts modified at or after it, when the user model records a modification time; ignored on a model that does not.

addressable_only.description: Default true: skip accounts with neither e-mail nor phone. Send false to enumerate every account.
